title: Ishigaki vs Miyako: Which Okinawa Island Should You Visit?
verdict: Miyako for beaches and pure relaxation, Ishigaki for diving, island hopping, and variety.

categories.name: Beach Quality
categories.summary: Yonaha Maehama is one of Japan's finest beaches with impossibly turquoise water.

categories.name: Diving & Snorkeling
categories.summary: Manta Scramble at Ishigaki is one of Asia's best manta ray dive sites.

categories.name: Island Hopping
categories.summary: Ishigaki is hub for Taketomi, Iriomote, and the Yaeyama Islands.

categories.name: Food & Restaurants
categories.summary: Ishigaki City has a proper dining scene including local Ishigaki beef.

categories.name: Nightlife & Vibe
categories.summary: Ishigaki City has izakayas and bars; Miyako is very quiet after dark.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Miyako requires a car; Ishigaki City center is walkable.

faq.question: Which has better beaches, Ishigaki or Miyako?
faq.answer: Miyako wins — Yonaha Maehama is routinely voted Japan's best beach.

faq.question: Which is better for diving?
faq.answer: Ishigaki — Manta Scramble is one of the world's best manta ray dive sites.

faq.question: Do you need a rental car?
faq.answer: Mandatory in Miyako; strongly recommended but optional in Ishigaki city.
